verdict.rationale: Ollama documents a REST API for running and managing models. It publishes a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1.0 spec for its HTTP API and states a stability and backwards-compatibility commitment, backed by curl examples, Python/JS libraries and OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible endpoints. The 404s on ollama.com OpenAPI paths do not contradict this, since the spec is served from docs.ollama.com. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of programmatic API use, an interactive in-docs API explorer, and a formal versioning/sunset scheme.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
